name: GO GREEN Food Packaging Solutions from CPT (Coextruded Plastic Technologies) Inc.

about:
Coextruded Plastic Technologies (CPT) Inc., operating as GO GREEN Food Packaging Solutions, was founded in 2001 in Janesville, Wisconsin. The company began with the founders' entrepreneurial drive to develop green thermoforming capabilities for packaging.

The company manufactures thermoformed trays and lidding solutions for food and medical packaging. Its proprietary Go Green thermoforming technology reduces carbon footprint by up to 28% compared to conventional methods. Product lines include GO-POLYPRO™ polypropylene trays, GO-PAPER™ paper-based trays, GO-VSP™ vacuum skin packaging, and GO-OVERWRAP™ overwrap solutions, as well as pre-padded trays in various colors and compartment configurations. The company holds several patents for its tray designs, such as the Zazin tray with beveled sidewalls that save 40% in cube space.

GO GREEN serves the food packaging and medical packaging sectors. Its solutions address needs such as extended shelf life, modified atmosphere packaging (MAP), vacuum skin packaging (VSP), oven- and microwave-safe trays, and sustainability goals including recyclability and reduced carbon footprint. Customers include food processors seeking brand-differentiated tray designs and medical device manufacturers requiring sterile packaging.

The company was founded to pioneer environmentally responsible thermoforming. It differentiates itself with capabilities such as the only polypropylene tray that can be registered printed, a Flex Flange design compatible with conventional overwrap equipment, and a thermoforming process that cuts carbon emissions by up to 28%. The Zazin tray’s beveled sidewall design reduces shipping volume by 40%, offering supply chain savings.
